verdict: Leads are accelerating, but none are converting to cases yet.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 148 leads from Meta at $12.47 per lead, and the trend is moving in the right direction — leads rose 20% and cost per lead dropped 8% in the most recent week. The problem is downstream: zero leads have been logged as active opportunities in your pipeline, which means the ads are working but the intake process is not converting inquiries into cases. Resolving the pipeline gap is the immediate priority, and several automation and tracking items that are needed to fix this are being pushed to completion now. Next period, expect continued lead volume at or near this pace while the intake gap is actively closed.

watch_item.issue: Leads are entering your system but not becoming tracked opportunities — the intake pipeline shows zero conversions despite 148 leads delivered.
watch_item.fix: SMS automation, CRM auto-logging, and case tracking are being brought live now to close the gap between lead arrival and case intake.
